name: Potato and Sausage Casserole (Papa Turmada)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup hogao with 6 sliced fried pork sausages

steps: Cut bread into small squares and wet with milk.
Grease a 9 x 13-inch (about 25 x 32-cm) Pyrex baking dish.
Put a layer of potato, then a layer of hogao and sausage, a layer of sliced egg, a layer of wet bread and a layer of mozzarella cheese. Optionally, add thyme to the hogao.
Repeat with another layer of potato, wet bread, and Parmesan cheese.

culture.text: La papa turmada is a baked potato and criolla sauce with sausage casserole, from Cucuta, Norte de Santander Colombia.
